algorithms.canonicalization: RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (npm package canonicalize)
algorithms.deviceCredential: mutation.author.deviceCredential is the PEM-less base64 public key of the signing device, here the identity's own key acting as its first device, so it equals identityId and the same key signs
algorithms.digest: base64url(sha256(utf8(canonicalize(payload without id)))), also the value other operations list in parents
algorithms.oneToOneConversationId: "one-to-one:" + hex(sha256(utf8(firstIdentityId + ":" + secondIdentityId + ":" + networkId))), the two identity ids sorted ascending as plain strings
algorithms.signature: ed25519 over utf8(signingContent), standard base64 with padding (88 characters)
algorithms.signingContent: "pigeon:public-mutation:v1\n" + canonicalize(mutationBody), mutationBody being the mutation without its signature

description: Fixed vectors for client-signed conversation operations. Every value in derived is computed from input and the keys only, and a unit spec recomputes them with the real domain code, so they cannot drift.

admin.seedDerivation: sha256(utf8("pigeon-vector:admin")), PKCS#8 ed25519 private key with the 16 byte prefix 302e020100300506032b657004220420 in front of the 32 byte seed
